claim_text: We make sure we all go home safe and well.
metric_name: Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR); Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
value_unit: per million hours worked；per million hours worked
context_text: We care for and respect each other, our communities and the environment. We make sure we all go home safe and well.；The 12-month rolling Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) as at 30 June 2025 was 1.8 per million hours worked (June 2024: 1.04 per million hours worked). The 12-month Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) at 30 June 2025 was 3.6 per million hours worked (June 2024: 5.0 per million hours worked).；Safety performance FY21 FY22 FY23 FY24 FY25 Total Recordable Injury Frequency (TRIF) rate per million hours worked 2.1 2.4 3.2 5.0 3.6; Lost Time Injury Frequency (LTIF) rate per million hours worked 0.8 0.8 1.2 1.04 1.8.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告期内仍存在可记录伤害和损失工时伤害，绝对化表述“we all go home safe and well”与实际伤害数据不符。
notes: 价值观表述被实际安全绩效数据否定。
llm_reason: The claim's decisive assertion is an absolute guarantee that all employees return home safe and well, implying a zero-injury outcome. The provided evidence substantiates safety metrics but reports non-zero injury rates, specifically a Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) of 3.6 and a Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) of 1.8 per million hours worked. These numerical values indicate that recordable and lost-time injuries occurred, which directly contradicts the claim's assertion that all employees go home safe. Consequently, the evidence defeats the central assertion, indicating the claim materially overstates the safety achievement.
